risk_note: RV2 by path (agent stream, store, http, orchestrator/results, personal-data copy). Split from B3-08zd (D10-1522 / D10-1524): the cases red on main. (3) A rolled-back terminal transaction: findDelivered skips deliveries of a run whose terminal is written but whose assistant reply is NULL, so the same process cannot resolve that card_id next round (the asking run itself still resolves); pendingCard / PendingCardSource / onCardWritten retired (BR-AI-19 细则「助手回复落库」: cards are written with the terminal in one transaction). (4) Deletion during a run: save / recordDelivered / recordQuoted / appendChain take FOR SHARE on the session row and write nothing once it is detached; on a detached session final_event and end_draft are written with msg / fallback_q nulled (BR-AI-22 细则; spec-test r1 S2 ① ②). (7) History paging to the end with user-first ties (also in the personal-data copy) and a foreign cursor → 20001. (9) Disconnect backfill of result chains: a list kept without a frame switches the batch chain at once in receipt order (onUnframedCard, D10-1361); delivery records stay in the terminal transaction. Side effects reported to the orchestrator: replies stored before B3-08zc with NULL text can no longer be referenced; a pre-existing window (purge redacting end_draft between ending and finalization holds the run) is not introduced here. Frozen test/spec/agent/trace-retry/queue.test.ts (modify_existing rule_change, br BR-AI-19, D10-1522) — the five pendingCard assertions, before → after (D10-1550: each put back in place as "the queue has no pendingCard", exact block texts in modify_existing): [AC-B3-08y#2] `expect(queue.pendingCard(APP, SESSION, 'c2')).toBeNull();` → expect('pendingCard' in queue).toBe(false); [AC-B3-08y#3] `expect(queue.pendingCard(APP, SESSION, 'c2'), code).toBeNull();` → expect('pendingCard' in queue).toBe(false); [AC-B3-08y#4] `expect(queue.pendingCard(APP, oldest.sessionId, 'c2')).toBeNull();` and `expect(queue.pendingCard(APP, third.sessionId, 'c2')).toEqual(orderCard('c2'));` → expect('pendingCard' in queue).toBe(false); [AC-B3-08y#6] `expect(queue.pendingCard(APP, SESSION, 'c2')).toBeNull();` → expect('pendingCard' in queue).toBe(false); imports APP, SESSION removed (unused); the other 13 tests are byte-identical (red_exempt + red_exempt_outside); new [AC-B3-08zh#1] asserts the queue has no pendingCard (Codex, test attempt 2, D10-1537). Rule tests by Codex (B3-08zd attempt 1; split, fixture fix and renames by fresh independent Claude). Test machine: red/2 PASS at the spec commit; verify:fast green (D10-1503); full verification is the required CI checks (approvals #21). Reverse check (D10-1550): restoring pendingCard on the queue turns exactly the four changed tests and [AC-B3-08zh#1] red (test machine --tests queue.test.ts, tests/2); with the implementation trace-retry and reply-persist-gaps are green (9 files, 38 tests, tests/1).
